info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Refunds-v2-spec
info.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of refunds associated with retail orders. It provides access to detailed information about each refund, including the reason for the refund, amounts, and associated order details. Typical consumers of this API include customer support teams and finance departments that need to track and manage refund processes efficiently. The data can assist in analyzing refund trends and enhancing customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve refund information for an order
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the refunds associated with a specific order. It provides comprehensive information regarding the status, amount, and date of the refund, enabling users to monitor their order refunds effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a refund operation on orders. This body must include the necessary details required for processing the refund, as defined by the schema.

200.description: The refund request has been processed successfully, returning the refund details.
